tweets.text:
Find it pretty helpful to have multiple trading accounts focused on different timescales.

Having a degen account can help you stay patient on your main portfolio by feeling like you're not missing moves by sitting idly risk off. 

Having long term portfolio structured as long only makes it so that you're never rooting for the market to go down for too long, and you're never coping while assets gradually drift higher due to inflation.
